#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long power(long long base, long long exponent) {
    if (exponent <= 0LL) {
        return 1LL;
    }
    long long result = 1LL;
    long long bit = 1LL << 63;
    while (bit != 0LL && (bit & exponent) == 0LL) {
        bit >>= 1;
    }
    while (bit != 0LL) {
        result = (result * result) % MOD;
        if ((exponent & bit) != 0LL) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
        bit >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);
    long long N, M, L, R;
    ss >> N >> M >> L >> R;

    long long totalCells = N * M;
    long long colorCount = R - L + 1;
    long long p = power(colorCount, totalCells);

    if (totalCells % 2 == 1) {
        cout << p << endl;
    } else if (colorCount % 2 == 0) {
        cout << (p * ((MOD + 1) / 2) % MOD) << endl;
    } else {
        cout << ((p + 1) * ((MOD + 1) / 2) % MOD) << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
